newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal's inflation rate drops to 1.1 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Senegal's inflation rate drops to 1.1 pct in July.

text.p: Senegal's benchmark inflation index, measuring consumer price changes for an African family, rose by 0.1 percent in July compared with June, bringing the annual inflation rate down to 1.1 percent from 2.2 percent.
The government is aiming to hold inflation to around 2.5 percent in 1997.
The index that measures a basket of European-style goods and services showed a year-on-year inflation rate of 3.1 percent in July, up from 2.6 percent in June.
Inflation in the first seven months of the year was 0.5 percent for the benchmark African index, and 0.7 percent for the European basket.
